title: Preallocate CREATE INDEX data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when CREATE INDEX backfill scans build data:<table>: prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added create_index_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Replaced CREATE INDEX existing-row backfill scan prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: CREATE INDEX data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving BTree, composite, FTS, trigram, HNSW, and row-cache backfill behavior.
